initial_message: I cannot log in to my company account after resetting my password.
resolution_summary: Verify the username, confirm the password reset completed, check whether the account is locked, and contact IT if access is still blocked.

initial_message: My laptop is connected to Wi-Fi but the internet is not working.
resolution_summary: Check whether other devices can access the internet, reconnect to Wi-Fi, restart the network adapter, and verify VPN settings.
